dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the posterior margin, with a deepening spline curve toward the insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius at the terminal point of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear incline relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex arc forming a bulbous, prominent forehead.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust projection with a high thickness-to-length ratio compared to the cranial mass.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clearly defined obtuse angle at the junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced tripartite pigmentation pattern with a dark dorsal cape, medium-grey flank, and a bright white ventral patch.
